card.name: The word everyday before a noun
card.fires_on: The adjective "everyday" placed before a noun such as life, activities, things or person, after words like our, their, the or in.

modes.label: Everyday life
modes.description: "everyday" follows "our" or "in" and leads into life or lives.
modes.example: The four digit PIN is a common part of our<< everyday>> life.

modes.label: Everyday things or people
modes.description: "everyday" describes ordinary activities, people or sense of a term.
modes.example: excessive, uncontrollable and often irrational worry about<< everyday>> things that is disproportionate

card.plain: It lights up on the word "everyday" when it describes ordinary daily life.
